shortDescription: Create, update, or delete an endpoint-hosted service based on the advanced service model

options.name: attributes
options.description: A list of service role attributes prefixed with a \#hash mark to be matched by an AppWAN

options.name: clientHosts
options.description: the domain names and IPv4s to intercept

options.name: clientPorts
options.description: port ranges to intercept e.g. ["80", "88:99"] as strings

options.name: clientProtocols
options.description: the transport protocol to intercept. TCP is default.

options.name: edge_router_attributes
options.description: A list of Router role attributes prefixed with a \#hash mark that may be used to access this service. Default is ["#all"].

options.name: encryptionRequired
options.description: require edge-to-edge encryption (E2EE) from intercept or SDK to hosting endpoint

options.name: endpoints
options.description: a list of endpoint names, role attributes, or UUIDs to host this service

options.name: network
options.description: The dictionary describing the Network on which to operate from netfoundry_info.network.

options.name: serverHosts
options.description: optional list of domain names, IPv4, IPv6 of the server(s) reachable by the hosting endpoint. Default is client intercept address.

options.name: serverPorts
options.description: listening ports of the server(s) reachable by the hosting endpoint. Default is client intercept port(s).

options.name: serverProtocols
options.description: the transport protocol(s) expected by the server. Default is client intercept protocol(s).

options.name: transparentHosts
options.description: optional list of IPv4, IPv6 CIDR to allow. If specified, the terminating endpoint will transparently masquerade as the source address and protocol of the intercepted packet and will ignore serverHosts, serverPorts, serverProtocols.

options.name: wait
options.description: seconds to wait for async create
